What we do

Everything to get you water

From finding the right spot to casing the hole, we handle the drilling so you can focus on using the water.

Water siting

We survey your property and pick the best point to drill before any drilling starts, so you are not guessing where the water is.

Borehole drilling

Rig-based drilling for homes, farms and commercial sites. The first 40 metres are one fixed price; extra depth is charged per metre.

Double casing

Extra casing to protect the borehole where the ground needs it, at $22 per metre.

    Questions

    Good to know

    What is water siting?

    It is a survey of your property to find the best point to drill. It costs $50.

    How much does a borehole cost?

    The first 40 metres are $750. Each extra metre is $22. Double casing, where needed, is $22 per metre. Use the estimator above for a rough total.

    Do you drill for farms and businesses?

    Yes. We drill for homes, farms and businesses.

    How do I get a quote?

    Call 078 827 7385 or send us a WhatsApp message with your location and what you need. We will take it from there.
